meta.title: FIRE savings rate (50%)
meta.blurb: Put half of take-home pay toward investing and live on the other half. The years-to-independence readout needs the Future screen, not this split.
meta.after: Mr Money Mustache, The Shockingly Simple Math Behind Early Retirement (2012). The 50% default is the example the post uses (about 16 to 17 years on its assumptions; the post says about 16). Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author.
meta.status: derived (assumes 5% real return, 4% withdrawal rate, start at zero; working in the report). PROPOSED, NOT SHIPPED (FT-R-71): the catalogue ships only the Bucket method at launch.

checks.naming: FIRE is a movement label, not a brand. Credit Mr Money Mustache in meta.after only, with the "not affiliated" line; never put his name in the title. Nothing found in the AU register.
